## Checklist

- [ ] The entry is useful to VPS users, server administrators, developers or self-hosting users.
- [ ] The link is working and points to a high-quality resource.
- [ ] The description is factual, concise, starts with a capital letter and ends with a period.
- [ ] The entry is not an affiliate-only page or thin promotional page.
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, private dashboards or personal information are included.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
